description: Deterministic scoring test cases for the team-selection algorithm. Any native port (Swift/Kotlin) must reproduce these exact values. This file is duplicated verbatim into team-captain-ios and team-captain-android. Note: select_teams() itself uses randomness (shuffle + probabilistic swap search), so the *team assignment* is not pinned down here -- see docs/algorithm_spec.md for its approach.
